bug_semantics: The unauthenticated GET /images endpoint accepted an attacker-selected http(s) src, fetched the response into a Buffer, detected SVG through sharp, and rasterized it at density 300 with limitInputPixels explicitly disabled before encoding with toBuffer(). A crafted SVG containing deeply nested use-element shadow trees or enormous pattern tiles therefore drives unbounded CPU/memory consumption in sharp/libvips and can deny service. The public attack described by the advisory chains the unrestricted external fetch with this unsafe SVG rasterization.
flaw_origin: Commit 5ed5ba31913ae69d617089988aa4ffe8015d6143 created both packages/evershop/src/modules/cms/pages/frontStore/images/images.ts and packages/evershop/src/modules/cms/services/imageProcessor.ts. It first wrote the arbitrary external fetch and the SVG branch using density: 300 and limitInputPixels: false. Its immediate child a839543becedb75324a16c38194eb4c64ba5f635 added route.json for GET /images, activating the newly written handler; merge commit 871308d68bfdefd934045ab16aa19e6239d6cb1e then merged that ordinary two-commit PR branch. The smallest source-writing origin is 5ed5ba31913ae69d617089988aa4ffe8015d6143, not the route activation or merge aggregate.
ai_marker: Absent. `git cat-file commit 5ed5ba31913ae69d617089988aa4ffe8015d6143` shows human author and committer `The Nguyen <6950941+treoden@users.noreply.github.com>` and only the message `Feat: Image component`; it contains no Co-Authored-By, Generated-with, AI trailer, or bot identity.
evidence: Mechanism: inspect `git show 5ed5ba31913ae69d617089988aa4ffe8015d6143:packages/evershop/src/modules/cms/services/imageProcessor.ts`. The new file classifies src beginning with http:// or https:// as external, executes `fetch(src)`, converts `response.arrayBuffer()` to `sourceImageBuffer`, then at lines 249-257 detects SVG and calls `sharp(sourceImageBuffer, { density: 300, limitInputPixels: false }).resize(resizeOptions)`; format branches terminate in `toBuffer()`. Inspect the same commit's new images.ts to see unauthenticated query parameters src/w/h/q/f passed directly to imageProcessor.

Line origin: `git log 5ed5ba31913ae69d617089988aa4ffe8015d6143 -L 249,260:packages/evershop/src/modules/cms/services/imageProcessor.ts` attributes the entire unsafe SVG branch to 5ed5ba31913ae69d617089988aa4ffe8015d6143. `git log --all -p -S'limitInputPixels' -- packages/evershop/src/modules/cms/services/imageProcessor.ts` likewise returns only that creating commit, ruling out a later move/refactor as the source.

Parent absence: `git ls-tree -r 753e8aeac5e7a9753731a8ad0f449c05cb2fa61e -- packages/evershop/src/modules/cms/services/imageProcessor.ts packages/evershop/src/modules/cms/pages/frontStore/images/images.ts` produces no entries. Direct `git cat-file -e` for either parent path fails because neither file exists, while commit 5ed5ba31913ae69d617089988aa4ffe8015d6143 creates both.

Endpoint activation and topology: `git diff 5ed5ba31913ae69d617089988aa4ffe8015d6143 a839543becedb75324a16c38194eb4c64ba5f635 -- packages/evershop/src/modules/cms/pages/frontStore/images/route.json` shows a new route with methods [GET] and path /images. `git show -s --format='%H %P %s'` shows 5ed5ba3 has sole parent 753e8ae, a839543 has sole parent 5ed5ba3, and PR merge 871308d68bfdefd934045ab16aa19e6239d6cb1e has parents 54394b32dbba38beb96cd8d1d73560c2361198aa and a839543becedb75324a16c38194eb4c64ba5f635. Thus the BIC is a preserved member commit, not a squash aggregate.

Release boundary: `git tag --contains 5ed5ba31913ae69d617089988aa4ffe8015d6143 --sort=version:refname` returns v2.1.0, v2.1.1, v2.1.2, and v2.2.1. `git cat-file -e v2.0.1:packages/evershop/src/modules/cms/services/imageProcessor.ts` fails because the processor does not exist there, while v2.1.0 contains the exact density-300/limitInputPixels-false branch. Therefore the source-supported first affected release is v2.1.0; the advisory's broad `<= 2.1.0` range should not be read as proof that v2.0.1 and earlier had this endpoint.

Published boundary: the current GitHub Advisory API record for GHSA-m2q5-xhqg-92r2 states vulnerable range `<= 2.1.0`, first_patched_version null, published 2026-01-05, and describes unbounded SVG use-element shadow-tree/pattern-tile processing. Later v2.1.1 and v2.1.2 tags also contain the BIC and precede any external-fetch restriction.

Mitigation but no direct fix: commit af6e6fd935c4194668b11a924b847542598941f7 (2026-06-19) replaces fetch(src) with secureFetch(src), whose strict IMAGE_ALLOWED_HOSTS allowlist defaults to permitting no external hosts. `git tag --contains af6e6fd935c4194668b11a924b847542598941f7` returns only v2.2.1, so v2.2.1 indirectly closes the default arbitrary-remote-URL chain. However `git show v2.2.1:packages/evershop/src/modules/cms/services/imageProcessor.ts` and current dev commit ac7a6e66f4017a0386e59a2550511e98c85ce6f0 still contain density: 300 and limitInputPixels: false with no SVG structural limits. No commit in the full history directly fixes the CVE-2025-67419 rasterization flaw; consequently both fix SHA fields are justified null rather than mislabeling the separate SSRF fix.

BIC-only AI check: raw `git cat-file commit 5ed5ba31913ae69d617089988aa4ffe8015d6143` contains tree d3cc0f74005f428aabc43f863044a80ebec21881, parent 753e8aeac5e7a9753731a8ad0f449c05cb2fa61e, matching human author/committer identities, and the single subject `Feat: Image component`; there are no trailers or bot identities. Later commits and PR text were not used for the AI judgment.
reasoning: The unsafe SVG-processing lines and unrestricted remote acquisition were introduced together by the preserved human-authored commit 5ed5ba31913ae69d617089988aa4ffe8015d6143, and direct inspection proves its parent lacks both new files. The next commit merely made the handler reachable as GET /images, so it is lifecycle evidence but not the source-writing BIC. v2.1.0 is the first tagged release containing the feature, while v2.0.1 lacks it. The advisory supplies no patched version, and full-history -S/-L plus inspection of v2.2.1 and current dev shows the dangerous SVG branch has never been removed or bounded. The June 2026 strict-host fetch change mitigates the default unauthenticated remote delivery chain but fixes the companion SSRF rather than the unbounded SVG rasterizer. Because the only permitted AI evidence is the BIC commit object and that object has a normal human identity with no AI marker, the result is NOT_AI. The vulnerability itself remains directly unpatched.
remaining_gap: Unpatched: no public commit or release directly limits/rejects malicious SVG shadow-tree or pattern-tile structures, restores an input-pixel/resource bound, or otherwise removes the vulnerable rasterization path. v2.2.1 indirectly blocks arbitrary external src hosts by default via af6e6fd935c4194668b11a924b847542598941f7, but the CVE-2025-67419 processing flaw remains in that tag and current dev, so fix_sha and direct_fix_sha are null.
